guard: A hosted runtime create or status request is decided only for a manager actor whose own ledger row holds supervise, at its own instance's current open manager gate, at the current serve epoch, with the host-issued registration proof, for a target owned by the authenticated owner; both closed schemas refuse any provider reference; the decision carries only owner, instanceId, actor and target; stock refuses both kinds rather than answering them
why: The ledger mutation decides without reading the manager actor's ledger row. A host composing the door would then authorize a manager actor the owner never granted; the suite names the cell for an actor with no row.
The supervise mutation accepts any row. spawn and admin are ordinary agent capabilities, and the suite proves a row holding both is still refused.
The gate-state mutation accepts a frozen gate. A frozen gate is a takeover in flight, so a create admitted there would launch a runtime for a registration that is being replaced.
The epoch mutation accepts a stale serveEpoch, so a superseded manager process could keep creating runtimes after its successor took the gate.
The proof mutation drops the constant-time proof comparison. The proof is the only host-issued fact in the request, so without it every other coordinate is participant-supplied.
The target-owner mutation lets a request name another owner's target, which would let one owner's manager drive or read another owner's runtime.

The two closed-schema mutations let a providerRef through at the top level or a handle through in the target. The contract refuses a provider reference rather than ignoring it, so a host can never be handed one as if it were authority.
The dispatch mutation removes the unimplemented refusal, so a runtime request falls through to the manager-lifecycle issuer.

mutations.name: runtime door accepts a manager row without supervise
mutations.find:
if (!scope.includes("supervise"))
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `${what} needs scope "supervise"; spawn/admin do not imply it`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: runtime-create: a manager row without "supervise" is refused even holding spawn and admin
mutations.cell: runtime-create: a manager row without "supervise" is refused even holding spawn and admin

mutations.name: runtime door accepts a frozen manager gate
mutations.find:
if (!gate || gate.state !== "open")
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", `${what} found no current open manager gate for instance ${r.instanceId}`);
mutations.replace: if (!gate) throw new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", `${what} found no current open manager gate for instance ${r.instanceId}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: runtime-create: a FROZEN gate is refused
mutations.cell: runtime-create: a FROZEN gate is refused

mutations.cell: runtime-create: a stale serve epoch is refused as a conflict

mutations.name: runtime door stops checking the host-issued registration proof
mutations.find:
if (!timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(r.registrationProof), Buffer.from(expectedProof)))
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `manager ${what} proof does not match current host registration`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: runtime-create: a forged registration proof is refused
mutations.cell: runtime-create: a forged registration proof is refused

mutations.name: runtime door accepts a foreign target owner
mutations.find:
if (r.target.owner !== args.owner)
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `${what} target owner "${r.target.owner}" does not match authenticated owner "${args.owner}"`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: runtime-create: a target owner that is not the authenticated owner is refused
mutations.cell: runtime-create: a target owner that is not the authenticated owner is refused
